inputs.text: [excited] It was 9 meters long — as long as a truck! [quickly] Standing up, it was 2.5 meters tall — as tall as a soccer goal! And it weighed 1,700 kilos — [amazed] as heavy as a small car and a cow put together! [serious] And it could swim about 14 miles an hour — as fast as Dad running.
[gasps] Did it have a long snout, like a crocodile?
[confident] Yes. [serious] A narrow snout full of pointy teeth, perfect for grabbing slippery fish.
